name: U-Line®  Home Collection 24" 4.9 Cu. Ft. Panel Ready Dual-Zone Wine Refrigerator with Glass Door
shortDescription: The Home 24" Dual-Zone Wine Refrigerator is the perfect companion for wine enthusiasts, offering a spacious 4.9 Cu. Ft. capacity that comfortably holds up to 35 bottles on five full-extension metal wine racks. Perfect for both indoor and outdoor spaces, this model features a sleek black interior accented with stainless steel, enhancing any decor with a touch of sophistication. Its dual-zone design allows for precise temperature settings between 34°F and 70°F in each zone, managed effortlessly through an electronic touch control system. Set the mood with six-color interior lighting options, including bright white, warm white, cool white, light blue, deep blue, and teal. A stainless glass door finish offers a timeless look, while panel-ready glass and solid door options allow for customization with your own panel and hardware, or opt for the accessory door wrap options. Whether hosting a gathering or enjoying a quiet evening, this wine refrigerator adds sophistication to any occasion, keeping your collection perfectly preserved and ready to serve. *CUSTOM PANEL & HANDLE SOLD SEPARATELY*

features.text: Black interior with stainless steel accents

Six-color multi-point LED lighting in adjustable white: bright white, warm white, cool white, and light blue, deep blue and teal
5.1 Cu. Ft. capacity stores up to 35 wine bottles
Cantilever adjustment points for complete interior adaptability
Five full-extension metal wine racks
